newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu leaves French villa, possibly for check-up.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu leaves French villa, possibly for check-up.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko left his luxury villa on the Riviera on Monday, possibly for a medical check-up after surgery for prostate cancer in August, eyewitnesses said.
Mobutu, convalescing in France during a refugee crisis in eastern Zaire, was driven from his personal mansion at Roquebrune-Cap-Martin along the coast towards Monaco on Monday morning.
Last week, Zairean Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo told a news conference in Kinshasa that Mobutu was due to have a medical check-up on November 25th and would return home three days later.
Mobutu, 66, has kept a low profile since his arrival at the palatial Riviera villa on November 4 after surgery for prostate cancer in Switzerland.
